record.Source: kim-kim2008bishnupriya[Appendix B.3, printed p. 35, item 5, Tilakpur]

accepted.evidence: Full meghya section 1 explicitly records Pothwari meghlu and Punjabi meghla cloud. Bishnupriya meghala cloud matches this l-extended cloud family with a vowel breaking the cluster. Prefer the attested extended family to bare megha 10302; exact local development and cross-IA transmission are qualified, and a specific Punjabi donor is not asserted. Exact response: meghala.
